summary: Flathead County, MT lookout: Roy Davis staffed it in 1930 (Forest history); firelookout.com dates an L-4 cab to 1931 and destruction to 1957. Site today undocumented.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1957, the Forest Lookouts page says removed; no source describes the site today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1931. The Forest history places the lookout building in the 1930 season, and the Forest Lookouts page also gives 1930. The 1930 date has the stronger support; the 1931 date is not explained by any source read.

sources.title: Trails of the Past, history of the Flathead National Forest
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Flathead National Forest

notes_for_editor: The 1930 account of Roy Davis and the first lookout building rests on the Flathead forest history PDF, which cites Howard 1984 and Davis 1980. The forest history does not say what type of building was put up, so the L-4 type rests on firelookout.com alone. Fate conflicts: firelookout.com says destroyed in 1957, the Forest Lookouts page says removed with no date. Site today, access and remains: not described in any source read. Two web searches on Tuchuck found no other lookout history.
